apps.short_description: A first-person psychological horror game. Play as Marlene, an 86-year-old woman preparing for her family's visit. They're coming. They always do.

apps.name: Ashley AI
apps.short_description: No te pide tu atención, se la queda. Una compañera de escritorio con IA para Windows que habla contigo, te recuerda y controla tu PC de verdad ❤️.

apps.name: Ashram Online
apps.short_description: The world broke a thousand years ago and no one is coming to fix it. Ashram is a classic MMORPG with a survivalist soul: hunt, dismantle and craft every piece you wear. Gather your guild, choose your path... and claim your eternity.

apps.name: ATOM RPG 2
apps.short_description: A New Open-World Era of ATOM Begins! 1,225 km² of the Caspian Wastes! Open-world survival game with a story-rich CRPG soul, co-op or alone, vehicles, sandbox, crafting, and strange encounters.

apps.name: Avlo the Imp Wizard
apps.short_description: Do the sickest tricks while reaching the finish line the fastest you can!

apps.name: Backrooms : The Threshold
apps.short_description: A 1–4 player co-op investigation horror game where you enter the Backrooms through an experimental gateway. Explore procedurally generated environments, document anomalies, recover valuable artifacts, and survive the unknown.

apps.name: Bananageddon
apps.short_description: Bananageddon is a roguelite in which you will have to create and adapt your equipment to defeat the hordes of animals, who will try to prevent you from getting out with the bananas harvested for your tribute!

apps.name: Baskets and Blooms
apps.short_description: Grow what you sell and sell what you grow in this cozy, pressure-free third-person farmer's market simulator. Choose your agricultural identity, nurture your farm at your own pace, play road-trip minigames, and serve customers face-to-face as your small business blooms!

apps.name: Battle Gaze
apps.short_description: Battle Gaze is a fast-paced 2D retro action-adventure hack-and-slash. Master 5 unique weapons—sword, bow, deadly claws, light sword, and hay fork—unleash fluid combos, and defeat ruthless bosses across dangerous lands to reclaim your ancestral heritage!

apps.name: Bee Shrimp Aquarium
apps.short_description: A 3D aquarium game for watching bee shrimp. Zoom in to see them graze, groom and swim, or feed them and watch them gather. Choose from 12+ aquascapes, change the lighting, and customize the shrimp's patterns, colors and sizes.

apps.name: Before it Falls
apps.short_description: Enter the long-closed St. Elora Hospital for a final technical inspection before demolition. Restore power, explore the building, and examine the records left behind. Before it Falls is a first-person psychological horror game focused on exploration and environmental puzzles.

apps.name: Beyond Grief
apps.short_description: An action roguelike set in ancient Egypt where you battle the gods, grow absurdly powerful through build-breaking synergies, kill, die and be reborn. Earning allies, making enemies, and befriending cats along the way.

apps.name: Blade Dodger
apps.short_description: A 2D arcade style arena survival game. As Spiff, you will sprint, dodge, and use your special abilities to stay alive long enough to make it through different levels and challenges. Features single player, 2-4 player local co-op, and 2-4 player online multiplayer.

apps.name: Blamcon's Cyber Range
apps.short_description: A day at the range for your Light Gun. Six real range target games on an outdoor range in the woods: paper, a speed plate rack, hanging steel, pop-up targets, a dueling tree, and a Texas star. This can be played with a mouse but it is a light gun game first, best played with Blamcon light guns.

apps.name: Blockfall
apps.short_description: BLOCKFALL is a first-person shooter in a blocky, fully destructible world made to enjoy with friends. Each round, gain an upgrade of your choice from a randomly selected array to boost your odds of victory. no two matches will be the same!

apps.name: Board Kingdom
apps.short_description: 24 board games in one kingdom. Play Chess, Go, Xiangqi, Shogi, Reversi, Mancala and more against computer opponents. Learn new rules, pick your challenger and build a record in every game.

apps.name: Bonobros
apps.short_description: A free strategy game where both sides play at the same time. Plan three actions in secret, then watch everything resolve at once: moves, spells, duels. Take on other players in 1v1, or play solo with lessons and puzzles, including ones made by the community.

apps.name: Bot Colony _redux
apps.short_description:
Use your mic or type: SAY ANYTHING—the robots understand!
In this sci-fi adventure, talk to characters in your own words and command them to manipulate the world as you hunt a spy.
Explore a tropical island where machines have real personalities and emotions. 
Total conversational freedom.

apps.name: Brain Cell
apps.short_description:
Brain Cell is a co-operative multiplayer adventure game. Play up to 4 players co-op to explore dungeons, complete puzzles, with twisting gravity physics.

Explore huge worlds with friends. Work together to complete mind bending puzzles and defeat bosses.

apps.name: Brighter than Burning
apps.short_description: A fast-paced running-focused platformer inspired by classic side-scrollers.

apps.name: Broken Build Simulator
apps.short_description: Love roguelites? Well so do I! So I made a game that combines them all, with modes like 20 Minutes Till Lunch and Vampire Revivers. Blast away at ridiculous monsters in this highly detailed and accurate simulation of what playing a video game is like.

apps.name: Bubble Hunters
apps.short_description: Pop bubbles, dodge danger and master 100 handcrafted levels in this colorful 2D arcade platformer. Play solo or team up with a friend in online co-op, then chase high scores in Survival and Marathon modes.

apps.name: Bug Fix Billionaire
apps.short_description: Build the most successful video game store in town! Develop your own games, stock your shelves with the latest hits, and grow your small shop into the ultimate gaming empire with employees, an esports team, loot boxes, and much more.

apps.name: Burger Shooter
apps.short_description: Your burger was stolen. Now everyone pays. Dash through fast-paced retro-inspired levels, chain kills to survive, unlock new weapons and upgrades, battle dangerous mafia enemies, and fight your way to the final boss in this adrenaline-fueled FPS.

apps.name: BURN THE WITCH
apps.short_description:
THEY TOLD ME TO MAKE THE BURN THE WITCH.  ROGUELIKE IN THE DARK FANTASY SETTING.
I'M NOT AGAINST IT

apps.name: Can 'Em All
apps.short_description: A juicy first-person incremental game about turning cute creatures into cans. Kill them, collect their bodies, can them, and sell them. Make money, upgrade your weapons and machines, and produce more and more.

apps.name: Carry the Pack Rack
apps.short_description: One car, two drivers! Team up where one controls the steering wheel and the other handles the gas. Overcome obstacles through perfect coordination. Enjoy the chaos with local or online co-op. Can you reach the finish line without crashing?

apps.name: Cartomancy
apps.short_description:
Turn-based RPG style experience with emphasis on RNG and hints of team building strategy. Uncover a metaphysical mystery from an unlikely inheritance. Cipher the code and face the powers that may be.

This isn't just a game, It's an initiation.

apps.name: Cats Love Cakes
apps.short_description: Run a cozy bakery for cats! Experiment with ingredients, discover new recipes, serve your feline customers, and uncover six interconnected stories, each told from the perspective of a different cat.

apps.name: Ceto-7
apps.short_description: Ceto-7 is a single-player underwater survival horror. Play as a salvage diver navigating a flooded alien mining facility, hunted by an apex predator, and hired to destroy sensitive corporate data. The deeper you go, the harder it becomes to ignore what you've been hired to bury.

apps.name: Charming Blood: Twelve days
apps.short_description: Embrace darkness as an unwitting vampire in this choice-driven romance. Navigate ancient powers, brewing conflicts, and passionate relationships with four captivating vampires who could become your greatest allies – or something more. When night falls, will you surrender to its dangers?

apps.name: Cinderpeak
apps.short_description: Carry the last flame up a mountain that has gone dark. Cinderpeak is a hard, precise 2D platformer: jump, climb and dash through ten chapters, each with its own rule, with a flame on your head that is starting to remember who put it out.

apps.name: CluckFront
apps.short_description: CluckFront is a top-down PvP looter-shooter featuring mutant chickens as the main characters. Choose your combat elevation: hold your ground on a specific tier or storm the heights. Select from a variety of Makeshift weapons, and various maps, and three game modes—either on online or via LAN

apps.name: Coastal Cargo
apps.short_description: Coastal Cargo is a strategy simulation game about becoming the world's best Naval Logistician. Chart trade routes between ports in a sprawling archipelago. Drop boats, start transporting cargo, and earn your rewards. How long can your empire last in this ever more challenging environment?

apps.name: Cocaine Smuggler
apps.short_description: Smuggle illegal cargo across dangerous waters, evade the Coast Guard and DEA, upgrade your planes and boats, and make it home with the cash.

apps.name: Computer Sillow: Jobcersize
apps.short_description: The Computerian-Workplace-Initative! Need a Job? Need some Excersize? You need some Jobcersize!

apps.name: CONDEMNED: Nightfall
apps.short_description: Survival horror set in a dark 1950's NYC. In this social deduction tactical RPG, a curse has fractured a gathering of guests. Will you fight to survive the night as an *Innocent*, or embrace the shadows and hunt your peers as *The Cursed*? Uncover the truth to survive.

apps.name: Console Repair Simulator
apps.short_description: Inherit your uncle's dusty console shop on a Tokyo back street. Sell new hardware, haggle for used consoles, then open them up on the repair mat: unscrew every screw, find the fault, swap the part, power on. Restore, grade, resell, and turn the top floor into a 90s Game Saloon.

apps.name: Council & Conflict
apps.short_description: Assume the role of a national leader in an original world of competing powers, and steer your country through diplomacy, trade, internal politics, and war as crises test your ability to hold the state together and shape the world order. How will you lead?

apps.name: Cover Up!
apps.short_description: Hide in plain sight. Cover Up! is an online 30-players hide-and-seek where you are the camouflage: paint your body to melt into the world, hold your nerve as seekers stalk past, and win by being invisible in full view.

apps.name: Creature Lab 2
apps.short_description: Conquer the world in the name of science! Study DNA, create mutagens, and grow mutated limbs to design your own monsters. Send them on missions across the globe, spread panic, collect bodies, samples, and chemicals, then use them in your next experiments.

apps.name: Cult of the Red Heifer
apps.short_description: Horror RPG FPS set in a dystopian United States controlled by a fanatical cult determined to create the perfect Red Heifer. Play as the Firestarter, a normal person who has decided to resist the Cult against all odds

apps.name: Curvelicious 2
apps.short_description: The classic curve game, rebuilt in 3D as a party game for 2 to 4 on one screen or up to 8 online. Your Curve never stops and leaves a solid trail. Box your friends in, blast gaps through their trails and be the last one alive.

apps.name: Dark Eyes - Super Soldier 2
apps.short_description: Continue the fight in the Dark Eyes universe as the Super Soldier battles the Delma and the elite Alpha commander. Experience fast-paced combat, massive battles, stealth, upgrades, and powerful abilities in this chaotic sci-fi action shooter.

apps.name: Deblock
apps.short_description: A short, satisfying incremental game about breaking blocks. Dig deeper, unlock new tools and upgrades, and break even more blocks.

apps.name: Dejinochi
apps.short_description: Dejinochi is a tiny virtual pet that lives right on your desktop. Feed it, care for it, watch it grow into different creatures, and eventually say goodbye as it heads out into the world. Old friends might even come back to visit.

apps.name: Delivery Time
apps.short_description:
Jump! Grind rails! Boost through the city and deliver packages as quickly as you can while also scoring some style points!
Get ready for frantic time trials, loaded with parcels to deliver to happy customers.

apps.name: Delve Survivors
apps.short_description:
A blend of classic turn-based roguelike dungeon crawling with the intensity of modern survivors games. 
Set the pace with every step as you unlock multiple dungeons and blast through swarms of enemies! 
Gather loot, customize your build, and learn to survive.. the Delve!

apps.name: DEPOT
apps.short_description: DEPOT is a 1-6 player co-op horror game about working the worst warehouse shift imaginable. Find the items on your list, load your cart, pack the orders and ship them out, while trying not to attract the things roaming between the shelves.

apps.name: Dicebloom
apps.short_description: Roll the die and wake a twilight garden. Every hit sets off a chain of blooming: plants grow their neighbours, bees fly, seeds sprout and multipliers climb. Build a garden engine that pays a rising debt every week in this cozy dice roguelite.

apps.name: Dinghai: The Ocean Pillar
apps.short_description: Dinghai: The Ocean Pillar is an action RPG-roguelike set in the mythic world of the Classic of Mountains and Seas, where ancient gods, demons, and forgotten powers collide.

apps.name: DispatchControl
apps.short_description: Run a fire and ambulance dispatch center on real-world maps. Answer emergency calls, assess incidents and send the right crews while keeping units in reserve. Play Dispatch Control solo or in online co-op with up to six players, in free play or 16 campaign chapters.

apps.name: Driver Wars
apps.short_description: A chaotic and satirical late-stage capitalistic driving simulator. In this low-poly 3D world, live out the fantasies and nightmares of countless commuters gridlocked in traffic as you ram, blow up, set ablaze, toss donuts at, honk, grapple, and total hordes of terrible and aggressive NPC drivers.

apps.name: Duoshift
apps.short_description: Defend The Wall on a tactical 11x7 grid using your pair of battle vehicles. Outmaneuver waves of scavenged war machines, unleash game-breaking hacks and chain synergies. Draft, fight, and survive in this endlessly replayable tactical roguelite.

apps.name: DUSTBLOOM
apps.short_description: Team up with friends in this 1-4 player co-op survival game. Build and defend your base, automate your production, haul ore with your truck, and terraform a dead red desert into a lush green world. Craft weapons to survive nightly skeleton attacks and uncover the dark mystery of the lost 14th team.

apps.name: Echoes of Stella
apps.short_description: Echoes of Stella is a first-person horror adventure built around a unique echolocation device. Use it to navigate a distorted mirror world, revealing your surroundings in brief moments of clarity. Time your scans carefully, or risk exposing yourself.

apps.name: Elsewhere Owl Post
apps.short_description: A cozy resource management game where you sort magical packages and assign them to the perfect owl for successful delivery. Care for your hardworking owls, grow your clientele, and uncover their stories along the way. Discover distant lands as your owls travel far and wide to complete each delivery.

apps.name: Endless Reach
apps.short_description: Fly a smuggler's run into a swarm of thousands. Every orb you catch is XP and cargo. Stay and the heat brings turrets, then a boss. Call the jump, hold the zone while the drive charges, and bank it all. Die, and you keep a fraction. The music follows how well you fly.

apps.name: Estranged: Act I
apps.short_description: Estranged tells the story of a lone fisherman, whose ship is stranded on a mysterious island during a violent storm. Explore the rich environments and meet the curious inhabitants of the island as you find a way back to the mainland.

apps.name: Evilos
apps.short_description: Evilos is an action tower defense game where you play as an ancient evil sorcerer battling endless waves of do-gooders. Tear down the kingdom with a vast arsenal of evolvable magic weapons and spells, and bolster your defenses with elite minions across 10 acts. This time, you are the final boss!

apps.name: Evolution Survival
apps.short_description: Evolution Survival is a survival game where the universe evolves around you. The plants and animals you saw at the beginning will be different at the end, They may not even be there, the star may have gone supernova or shrunk into a white dwarf. Use the time you have to ensure your survival.

apps.name: Fall of the Final Age
apps.short_description: Take command of the last Stronghold of humanity, fighting back against the advancing monsters. Decide where to prioritize the forces of your Heroes, as the number of turns before the invasion is limited. A turn-based tactical strategy with RPG and roguelike elements.

apps.name: Fallen Crowns
apps.short_description: Four Kings and a Wizard once sealed the Abyss. Then the Wizard betrayed them, and the Kings fell. Rise from nothing and claim their four crowns across a war-torn fortress, storm-wracked skies, a corrupted grove and endless shadow. Grow stronger every run, then face the Wizard King himself.

apps.name: Feeding Gooble
apps.short_description: A roguelike deckbuilder about feeding the hungriest little guy. Push buttons, combine foods, and press your luck to keep him sated... or else.

apps.name: Find The Needle
apps.short_description: You have a shovel and a haystack with about six million strands in it. Somewhere inside there's a needle. Dig it out by hand, sell the hay, then spend the money on belts and machines until you don't have to dig anymore.

apps.name: Folk-Tography
apps.short_description: Folk-Tography is a 4-player co-op cryptid photography extraction game. Photograph legendary creatures, investigate paranormal anomalies, manage scarce resources, and survive various dangers to escape with the evidence before the valley consumes you.

apps.name: Forest Mind
apps.short_description: Escape the noise of the city and seek refuge in your grandfather's forgotten cabin. But as night falls, the forest begins to reveal something far more terrifying than you expected.

apps.name: Furry Snow Leopard
apps.short_description: Furry Snow Leopard is a seductive adult puzzle game featuring a charming snow leopard heroine. Uncover her boldest looks, unlock steamy illustrations, and step by step discover what lies behind her cold yet alluring gaze.

apps.name: FUTA gone WILD
apps.short_description: FUTA gone WILD - is a relaxing Arkanoid-style game where you destroy tiles to unlock hot animations with beautiful futanari.

apps.name: Futaland Love of the Dead
apps.short_description: Flirt with femboy and futanari characters in an 18+ NSFW visual novel mixing romance and zombie comedy. Build relationships through dialogue choices, unlock animated adult scenes, and tackle mini-games where you prepare pizza orders, mix cocktails, solve puzzles, and test your timing.

apps.name: Genome Warriors : Resistance to Invasion
apps.short_description: In this roguelike top-down shooter game, progress by defeating enemies in randomly generated levels. Upgrade your cell, gain advantages with temporary boosts, and try different strategies each time.

apps.name: Ghosts Don't Need Doors
apps.short_description: Even ghosts dream of freedom! Help a little ghost escape a haunted mansion, where everyday objects hide clues to secret passages. Observe, deduce, and slip through walls to reach the moonlight.

apps.name: Gnome Acres
apps.short_description: A cozy farming game where a village of gnomes does the work. Draw fields, pick what grows, and watch your gnomes plant, water, harvest and haul every crop through spring, summer, autumn and winter.

apps.name: Grandpa's Garden
apps.short_description: Grow weed, roll joints and deliver to your customers in this top-down pixel crime game while the police patrol the streets. Hire dealers and gardeners, launder your money and turn a motel room into an empire. Play alone or with up to five friends.

apps.name: Gravefever
apps.short_description: Punch, gun down, and freeze endless waves of monsters in this survivors-style roguelike. Grow your build from skill branches and capstones, topple mega-bosses to reach new arenas, and bank gold for permanent training. Every run ends in death — the clock is your score. How long can you last?

apps.name: Graveyard Cabin
apps.short_description: An FMV anomaly horror game. You are a night guard at a desolate graveyard. Monitor the cameras, spot the unnatural, and survive.

apps.name: Gravity Defied Reincarnation
apps.short_description: An unofficial remake of the 2004 keypad phone classic. Lean the rider to keep the bike balanced, ride over hills and drops and reach the finish on 30 tracks. Original mode rebuilds the classic physics, Modern mode rides smoother. Four bikes, pixel art and 31 original songs.

apps.name: GRINDWORM
apps.short_description: A short horror game where you pilot a grinddozer through a nightmare buried underground. Why are the walls twitching? Is that flesh? Yes. It is. This is no longer mining. This is surgery... DON'T. STOP. DIGGING.

apps.name: Guns 'n Goblins
apps.short_description: Face a deluge of monsters in this incremental horde survivor FPS. Build your Bastion, level up your character, and upgrade your arsenal to rise from Apprentice Bell Ringer to Master Dragon Hunter.

apps.name: Heartreave
apps.short_description: A turn-based hack-and-slash where every fight is played with cards. Assemble a party, solo or in online co-op, and craft unique builds by combining cards, passives, talents, relics, creature hearts and island hearts to find the best synergies and push ever deeper.

apps.name: Higanbana
apps.short_description: A co-op souls-like, where a young Samurai and cursed Doll work together to traverse an abandoned land swarmed with Yokai. Together with a spear and magic, they must defeat the challenging foes and unforgiving bosses to restore the Dolls original body and save the Samurai’s village.

apps.name: How to Farm
apps.short_description: A chaotic co-op farming game where the crops don’t always cooperate. Plant strange seeds, wrangle runaway vegetables, and harvest increasingly bizarre plants with your friends as your farm descends into chaos.

apps.name: Hull Rupture
apps.short_description:
If the ship stops, humanity ends.

Manage a spaceship, treat puny humans as resources, and repel relentless alien assaults in a base-management tower-defense roguelite where every choice seemed reasonable at the time.

apps.name: Hyoshi: Rhythm Sumo
apps.short_description: Sumo is a battle of rhythm. Read your opponent's patterns, strike to the beat of taiko drums, and hold your ground in the ring. Practise the phrases that beat you, find your moment to commit, and return prepared.

apps.name: Ink & Lore
apps.short_description:
A 99-floor roguelike of cards that vanish the moment they're played.

Lead two guardians of living stationery into a picture book someone stopped drawing. Your cards are finite—choosing when to spend them is life or death.

And at the end of the world waits the one who—

apps.name: ISTAKA
apps.short_description: ISTAKA is a single-player roguelite deckbuilder where you battle with Okey tiles. Form melds to deal damage, build powerful combos with special tiles, and cheat to turn the tables. Face masked opponents, upgrade your rack, and choose your path to the top as techno beats pulse around you.

apps.name: Jade Valley
apps.short_description:
Clear a quiet Chinese village, one rock at a time. 
Stack stones, carry them to the saw, and discover precious jade in this cozy first-person cleanup game. 
Buy handy upgrades, offer jade to ancient statues, and uncover the valley's secret at your own pace.

apps.name: Krigo's PlayPlace
apps.short_description: as a relative of the founder of a children’s playplace, you finally come back to the place many years after it was abandoned and much more..

apps.name: Lagrange Front Idle
apps.short_description: Grow from a mere few ships to thousands of ships fighting in realtime and while you are away. Call down orbital strikes, rip through fleets with chained lightning, or watch from the comfort of your seat as your fleet expands and takes over the universe.

apps.name: LaurEli & the Blood Dipped Manor
apps.short_description: An Ace Attorney/Danganronpa style Murder Mystery-esque Visual Novel where an unlikely duo must find the vampiric killer stalking the halls of a stormy manor.

apps.name: Legend of Cina 2
apps.short_description: This game is made from the foundations of Legend of Cina, it's a turn-based strategy game and has 7 stages and 15 OSTs, each map will introduce a new character. The maximum level is 20 and characters can promote after level 10, they can also learn skills once they reach level 5 and 15.

apps.name: Leviathan: Rhino
apps.short_description: Live through the final days of an old man in a small village threatened by an approaching giant Leviathan. An existential horror game about inevitability, loneliness, and a man with nowhere to go and no reason to leave.

apps.name: Loonyland 2: Winter Woods
apps.short_description: In this sequel to Halloween Hill, Loony pursues the Happy Stick Witch into the frigid Winter Woods where he must confront a whole new set of problems in Action-RPG gameplay. Craft items, mix potions, cast spells, murder teddy bears, you know the drill!

apps.name: Lore: The Hunt
apps.short_description: Lore: The Hunt is an online asymmetric (4vs1) horror game where a relentless Hunter protecting their property tries to capture nimble Intruders as they try to break into catacombs under the Hunter's domain. Freerun or fight to escape or hunt down the Intruders using different powers and perks.

apps.name: Lost Gaijin
apps.short_description: Stranded in 1994 Japan with ¥250,000, a paper address, and almost no Japanese, you must interact, travel, and find your way through a persistent AI-directed world that teaches you the language as you play.

apps.name: Lunar Mining
apps.short_description: Mine, melt, upgrade, repeat. Lunar Mining is a fast, casual incremental game built around tense 15-second mining runs. Smash lunar ore, smelt it into bars, and upgrade your drill between runs. Explore three biomes, battle bosses for rare artifacts, and chase Legendary ores across the Moon.

apps.name: Magic Dragon Fantasy: Story
apps.short_description: Discover a world of adventure, fantasy, and magic in a vibrant hero quest, top-down retro-style pixel art action-adventure where fast-paced strategic positioning and well-timed attacks determine victory!

apps.name: Malibu Club: Cocktail Bar Simulator
apps.short_description: Run a cocktail bar under a Miami sunset. Read each guest's licence for the order, pour by eye until the gauge turns green, shake, stir, pull a proper pint, and fix up the room between nights. Pixel-art bar sim.

apps.name: ManaPop!
apps.short_description: ManaPop! is a new kind of competitive falling-block puzzle game where you solve puzzles while battling with magic! Clear the falling mana, build up magic power, cast spells, and fight for victory! Japanese only.

apps.name: March of Reveille
apps.short_description: Turn-based strategy where every Order is a trade-off. Capture cities, command combined forces, and take up to three Orders into a match — each granting one unique strength and one real weakness. Missions, online play, CPU skirmishes, King of the Hill, Domination, and a map editor.

apps.name: Mediotorum
apps.short_description: Enter Mediotorum, a fantasy world torn by rival factions. Collect cards, forge your deck, and face other players in turn-based duels where every decision can tip the balance of the war.

apps.name: MineMergeMatic
apps.short_description: Mine, merge, and automate! Combine ores into valuable resources, build compact production chains, unlock powerful machinery, and expand your cave into a bustling mining factory.

apps.name: Morse Operator
apps.short_description: The frontline depends on your radio. Tune in to Morse signals, crack enemy ciphers and track contacts on radar. Coordinate rescues and operations under pressure in a radio operator sim where a timely reply can save lives.

apps.name: My Army Getting Stronger
apps.short_description: A short relaxing incremental auto-battler where you grow an unstoppable war machine and grind your way forward through enemy territory. No stress, no micromanagement — just growth, upgrades, and glorious mass battles.

apps.name: My Tradwife is a Femboy?
apps.short_description: After your company nears collapse, a deal can save it if you marry the heiress of Anemaryn Capital. Lucy seems like the perfect 50s-style tradwife, until you discover she’s actually a femboy. Romance Lucy, Lexi, or both in this comedic, choice-driven visual novel.

apps.name: My Useless Hot MILF in the Party
apps.short_description: Forced into a dangerous expedition before the dungeon opens to the world, explore its depths in a classic first-person dungeon crawler. Train your MILF companion, solve puzzles, battle monsters, uncover secrets, and discover the truth hidden on the final floor.

apps.name: Neverending Descent
apps.short_description: Descend into an endless dungeon filled with deadly demons, powerful bosses, and valuable loot. Level up, upgrade your abilities, and collect stronger equipment as you fight your way deeper. Return safely with your treasures or risk everything to push further. How deep can you go?

apps.name: Nick vs the Brick of Ick from space
apps.short_description: Build an outrageous deck of alien cards and deploy them onto the battle field. Unleash game-breaking combos in this tactical roguelite deckbuilder.

apps.name: Night Drive - Anomaly
apps.short_description: Night Drive - Anomaly is a supernatural driving horror game where you must navigate a mysterious endless night, spot anomalies, choose the right road, and survive until morning to escape the loop.

apps.name: Obsidian Tower
apps.short_description: Defend the Obsidian Tower in a roguelike tower defense on procedurally generated hex paths. Build crossbows, flamethrowers, Tesla coils and mortars, combine fire, poison, ice and lightning, draft run cards between waves, and spend banked XP on permanent upgrades.

apps.name: Oh No, Meteor!
apps.short_description: Oh No, Meteor! is a short incremental game. Chop trees with your cursor, send lumberjacks, haulers, and miners to work, then spend wood, stone, and coins on a huge skill tree, talent cards, and artifacts before the meteor hits the town.

apps.name: Old Man's Sushi
apps.short_description: No free handouts, earn your legacy! Grandpa wants to leave his sushi shop to you, but he doubts you're ready. Catch fresh fish, roll delicious sushi, collect antiques, and clear Grandpa's To-Do List to prove your worth!

apps.name: On Love, On Monsters
apps.short_description: On Love, On Monsters is a Frankenstein-inspired story with an emphasis on love in its many forms. Play as three characters with alternating POVs; the Doctor, The Priest, and The Exile. Bond with allies and enemies, avoid raising suspicion in the town of Blackmoore, and learn what it means to love.

apps.name: OnzeFoot
apps.short_description: Manager de futebol clássico: assuma um clube num mundo de 8 países e 640 clubes, dispute liga, copa e um Mundial de clubes, negocie no mercado e responda a uma diretoria que cobra resultado. Gratuito para jogar, em Acesso Antecipado.

apps.name: Outliers: Incrementum
apps.short_description: An incremental ARPG about rising from a nobody to the most powerful assassin alive. Slash through waves of monsters, collect loot and upgrade your abilities. Get stronger with every run until even bosses become easy targets.

apps.name: Owl Skips
apps.short_description: Jokes end when the owl with a skipping rope appears. A cozy one-button roguelite with ridiculous builds and rope-fueled chaos. Charge jumps, stack wild upgrades, chase high scores, and try again. Just one more run. Probably.

apps.name: PIGFACE MASSACRE
apps.short_description: PIGFACE MASSACRE is a survival horror game can be played up-to 4 players. While trying to stay alive, uncover the serial killer PIGFACE's bloodcurdling mystery and find out the truth behind events.

apps.name: Pipfiend: The Demonic Domino Deckbuilder
apps.short_description: A roguelike deckbuilder about battling demons with a specialized deck of dominoes! Build your deck from nearly 75,000 possible unique configurations of dominoes, and augment your run with powerful charms and discover diabolical synergies.

apps.name: Project 14
apps.short_description: Project 14 is a short psychological puzzle game filled with bizarre tests, dark humour and unexpected twists. Explore strange environments, uncover hidden paths and decide whether to obey or defy a disturbingly polite system. Your actions shape the experience – and may lead to different outcomes.

apps.name: Puzzle Simulator
apps.short_description: The one-more-piece jigsaw game. Puzzle Simulator is a dangerously cozy puzzle adventure where you unlock shelf after shelf of boxes, satisfyingly sweep and sort pieces, collect rare charms, and puzzle your own photos.

apps.name: Quota: Hit Your Number
apps.short_description: Climb the sales ladder from the basement to the corner office. Cold-call, close deals, build a team, run a region — and hit your number every single month. A pixel-art idle career sim about the one figure that decides everything.

apps.name: RABIDZ
apps.short_description: An open-world co-op zombie survival game where the infected mutate every night you survive. Gather, craft, build and fight to see another sunrise.

apps.name: Raise a Graz
apps.short_description: Raise and grow your very own Graz! Make him burp, spend your Burpo on increasingly peculiarly snacks, and feed him until he's ready to Asscend. A crude, colorful clicker with goblins, Burpo Frenzies, leeching Giovannis and 2-player online or LAN co-op.

apps.name: Rayborne
apps.short_description: Rayborne is a puzzle game built around lasers, physics, and real-time light simulation. Solve handcrafted challenges by shaping light itself while uncovering the mystery behind a questionable AI research facility.

apps.name: REC:REWIND
apps.short_description:
Set in an American home, REC:REWIND follows a missing husband and the wife who refuses to stop searching for him.
Experience a “reverse loop” horror story, unraveling the truth through the eyes of both of them as you travel deeper and deeper into the past.

apps.name: Relocate Motorhome Simulator
apps.short_description: Drive 60 motorhomes across 12 handcrafted worlds and more than 300 km of road. Deliver RVs, start your own rental company, furnish your home on wheels, cook, adopt a pet and road-trip in cross-platform convoy with voice chat.

apps.name: Resident Evil 2 "R.P.D. Demo"
apps.short_description:
A deadly virus engulfs the residents of Raccoon City in September of 1998, plunging the city into chaos as flesh eating zombies roam the streets for survivors.

An unparalleled adrenaline rush, gripping storyline, and unimaginable horrors await you.

Witness the return of Resident Evil 2.

apps.name: RoboSquare: Recharged
apps.short_description: A 16-player online party game where hovering robots dash, jump and slam each other off the map across five chaotic minigames. Your friends are worse than you remember, and the platform is smaller than you think.

apps.name: Rooklite
apps.short_description: A minimalist game about building your board and fighting for checkmate.

apps.name: Sandkeeper
apps.short_description: A cozy sand art game. Pour colored sand into glass bottles one grain at a time: lean the glass to slope the layers, tap it to settle, press in a shell. Pour a bottle for each of the 48 places in your grandfather's book and keep them in his seaside cottage. No score, nothing can fail.

apps.name: SCALING LAW
apps.short_description: Build an AI company in a psychological-horror incremental game. Label data, train models, expand across a global map, and automate your staff. Read the emails and conversations left behind as success turns unsettling. Five acts. Multiple endings. You can still press the shutdown button.

apps.name: Scawy Game
apps.short_description: Kenguin Sting, a failed horror writer, buys a cheap asset-store house to write his masterpiece. His only job: feed the cats. And keep Grandma on her pills. And survive 4 days and 4 nights. An absurd parody horror game.

apps.name: Screen Stocks
apps.short_description: Screen Stocks is an online multiplayer trading game featuring a real-time simulated market. Buy, short, and sell stocks to gain unprecedented levels of wealth. Team up with other traders or outsmart them all. It's time to make some money!

apps.name: Sellsword Tales
apps.short_description: A young warrior leaves home on a journey filled with battles and new encounters. Your choices affect not only the outcome of fights but also the relationships you build. Will they stay friends, or will something more develop? The path is yours to decide…

apps.name: Serious Sam: The Third Encounter
apps.short_description: Serious Sam: The Third Encounter picks up exactly where 'The Second Encounter' left off, bringing classic run-and-gun mayhem to bold new worlds. Bigger hordes. Bigger guns. One last score to settle with Mental.

apps.name: Shadow at Noon
apps.short_description: An interactive sound novel for honkaku mystery fans. No cutscenes, no spectacle: just text, art and sound, with every clue you need on the page. Amesaka, 2015. A rich family's eldest son lies dead at the foot of his stairs; by morning the housekeeper has confessed. Every confession hides one lie.

apps.name: Siren's Well 2
apps.short_description: "The Crowley blood stains the mansion's hallways, where voices whisper horrors that time tried to bury."

apps.name: Sirens
apps.short_description: Become a deadly Siren and hunt down the most dangerous sea creatures that have ever swim in the depths of the oceans! Experience a fascinating journey through the world as seen from the perspective of Sirens at various stages of their evolution.

apps.name: Sketchy Warfare
apps.short_description: A turn-based tactical war game where stick-figure armies from across history collide. Command 11 unique teams, master dozens of units and weapons, and fight through a campaign for every era—from cavemen and pirates to modern soldiers, fantasy warriors, and the armies of the future.

apps.name: Smashboom
apps.short_description: "Smashboom" is a high-speed 3D competitive shooter where you deflect incoming projectiles and use feints to exploit your opponent's openings. Engage in tense mind games, unleash a surprise smash to catch your rival off guard, and take them down!

apps.name: SnatchDeck
apps.short_description:
Steal, Adapt, Survive!
SnatchDeck is a fast-paced and addicting card game that can be played both casually and strategically. Build a powerful deck on the fly by stealing cards from your opponents mid-round. You'll have to adapt your strategy round by round to avoid death.

apps.name: Soulful Slide
apps.short_description: A comfy and cozy sliding ice puzzle game with the twist of throwing snow along the path to solve puzzles. Featuring a combination of tranquil music and colorful art to bring in peaceful winter vibes. Collect gifts within levels to customize your own snowman as well.

apps.name: Souls Divided
apps.short_description: A single-player puzzle game where you divide your soul into two forms, each perceiving a different dimension. Switch between them, manipulate ancient instruments, and solve layered puzzles across overlapping realities in a mysterious astral world left behind by a failed civilization.

apps.name: Space Slinger
apps.short_description: Space Slinger is an arcade roguelike about a traveler and his recoil-packed gun where you shoot to move. Unlock unique weapons and broken builds as you conquer space one enemy at a time.

apps.name: Space Squadron Command
apps.short_description: A tactical, dice-based space combat game inspired by tabletop wargames. Plot your maneuvers, activate your squadrons, and fight using an array of ship-to-ship weapons as you build a persistent roster of ships and pilots across a galaxy-spanning campaign.

apps.name: SpellWeave
apps.short_description: Build a wand out of spell cards that modify and combine with each other, then fight down through an endless dungeon. Order is everything: a modifier changes every spell after it. No final floor — the run ends when you do.

apps.name: Stay Tuned
apps.short_description: Stay TUNEd is a simulation-based game, where you are an audio director, manipulating amateur band members' music to make them sound super super good! Hype up your audience; Boost band members' confidence by helping them out; Get introduced to the band; Enjoy the live concerts!

apps.name: StoneEra
apps.short_description: Build a medieval voxel colony in an editable world. Guide villagers, research technologies, craft supplies, trade with a travelling merchant, raise animals, and engineer flowing water. Shape the terrain and create reusable building plans as your settlement grows.

apps.name: Succubus Crawler
apps.short_description: An incremental dungeon crawler where a True Ancestor succubus strolls ever deeper, burning everything in her way. She walks and casts on her own. You sidestep, pick upgrades, and pour your gold into a huge sigil tree to push one floor further.

apps.name: SunderBound
apps.short_description: SunderBound is a co-op top-down shooter with roguelite progression, set in a crumbling mega-tower. Survive floor by floor with a partner you trust, or an AI companion if you’re climbing solo. Every room’s a test. Every upgrade’s earned. And the only way out is up.

apps.name: System Arrival
apps.short_description: Top-down co-op survival action RPG for 1–4 players in a world the System turned into a game. Earn levels, quests and psychic powers, scavenge the ruins, fight zombies and build an underground bunker for survivors — then find out what the System really wants.

apps.name: TCG: FANTASY Card Collection
apps.short_description: TCG: FANTASY Card Collection is a relaxing fantasy card-collecting game. Explore the room, discover thousands of cards, examine rare finds, and carefully organize your collection in cabinets by faction and rarity.

apps.name: Tearable Choices
apps.short_description: A card roguelite about ripping open booster packs. Crack boxes, rip packs, and score every pack by Attack × Power. Then face the real choice: sell your God-tier Legendary for cash, slot it into your Binder for permanent buffs, or send it off for grading and pray for a Gem Mint 10.

apps.name: Tech Legends Simulator
apps.short_description: Open a tiny PC shop and grow it into a tech empire. Stock shelves from Amazoom deliveries, ring up customers at a real cash register, build gaming PCs by hand, hire staff, run a LAN café, mine crypto and expand your HQ all the way to the second floor.

apps.name: Tennis & Padel Shop Simulator
apps.short_description: In Tennis & Padel Shop Simulator, run your own racket store! Stock shelves, string rackets, serve customers at the till and haggle over bulk deals. Keep the court in shape so club players book it by the hour, and grow a small shop into the town's favourite racket club. Enjoy padel and tennis!

apps.name: The Banishing Act
apps.short_description: The Banishing Act is a online co-op, horror investigation game. Demons are physically manifesting in the world and the number of haunted is on the rise. Play as a Banisher, find clues to identify Cursed Objects, and perform the Banishing Ritual, sending demons back to the abyss.

apps.name: The Big Suck
apps.short_description: An incremental game where you ARE the tornado. Suck up cows, flatten cities, and turn destruction into upgrades. Start with a blade of grass. Keep growing until you tear the planet apart.

apps.name: The Kept Fire
apps.short_description: Your brother’s hiking group vanished. Beyond the cave, the valley is hunting you. The beast only moves when you look away, but stare too long and you go blind. Keep your fire alive, find a way out, and remember: you can survive three encounters. Not four.

apps.name: The Time After
apps.short_description: A post-apocalyptic survival game with a focus on driving and third person shooting. Travel through open world locations on foot and in car while scavenging fuel, scrap, food, guns and ammo to continue the journey south and escape the killing heat. Learn how we ended up here as you journey,

apps.name: Thicc Magic. Perky Prelude
apps.short_description: The backstory of our kindest, fairest, most humble, and selfless ruler, in the form of a comedic hentai shoot 'em up.

apps.name: Those Far Stars
apps.short_description: Discover a vast, procedural galaxy as a lone pilot. Trade, fight and explore alien worlds with turn-based encounters. Upgrade your ship, gather relics, and uncover secrets lost to time and space.

apps.name: Throw a Barrel Down a Hill
apps.short_description: Throw a barrel down a hill. Buy upgrades. Throw it again. That's the whole game.

apps.name: Tideturn
apps.short_description: TideTurn is a dynamic third person shooter where diverse characters and water-based weapons clash in a fight over the world's oceans! Submerge into water your weapons create to move seamlessly across any surface. Fight the enemy with movement and abilities limited only by your creativity!

apps.name: Too Hot To Hold
apps.short_description: Grab the Ember and RUN! An up-to-10-player asymmetric party game of hot potato. Tiny Tricksters must pass the burning Ember every 10 seconds, while armed Wardens hunt them down and destroy it. Use abilities, set traps, and scream at your friends in chaotic proximity chat.

apps.name: Toon & Tune
apps.short_description: A Survival-Crafting Game combining all of your favourite mechanics from different games and genres. Fill your Item Collections, Max out your Weapons and Skills, Complete all Quests, Defeat Bosses, Increase your Stats, or just Build your Island.

apps.name: Traveloot
apps.short_description: Traveloot is a run-based incremental game where you guide a growing team of adventurers across islands. Gather resources, fight hordes of enemies, unlock branching skill tree, and find new party members to join your team. Play solo or with a friend in local co-op.

apps.name: Trifolium: The Adventures of Gary Pretzelneck
apps.short_description: Discover hidden truths about the world in this 3D adventure about a giraffe with an unreasonably long neck. Figure out the rules, solve strange mysteries, and stumble upon unexpected twists. Choose your own path.

apps.name: Ultimate Classic Car Racing 2
apps.short_description: A fast-paced local multiplayer party racing game for up to 8 players, featuring chaotic battles, multiple game modes, and responsive car controls.

apps.name: Ultra Auto Gotchimon
apps.short_description: Build a team of gotchimon, pick their moves and fighting order, then watch them battle on their own. Play the story campaign, take on other players' teams in the PvP Arena, and keep a run going in a small corner window while you work.

apps.name: University Architect
apps.short_description: University Architect is a management game where you build and run your own university. Build the campus, design the courses, manage the professors, and decide whether to prioritize profits or your reputation.

apps.name: V-BuddyUltraDeluxe
apps.short_description:
VBuddy is back, written from the ground up to be more featureful and better than ever!
Feed sweets and tiny people to a cast of colourful characters and unlock new toys, skins and backgrounds for your V-Buddy UltraDeluxe!

apps.name: Warcamp Rivals
apps.short_description: Recruit and equip a fantasy warband in this asynchronous PvP auto battler. Cook, brew, train, and forge gear between battles. Combine traits and powerful Edicts, then test your squad against other players’ saved armies. Climb the ladder to become the best Camp Manager.

apps.name: Waste Of Life
apps.short_description: You crashed on Garb'aaj, a planet made of trash, and you owe money for the ship. Scavenge, swap your body parts one finger at a time, fight drones built from garbage, and recycle the whole planet into a real one. Solo or co-op.

apps.name: Wizard Magic
apps.short_description:
An autistic wizard and their ADHD familiar go on the adventure of a lifetime.

Make strange friends, battle wizards and monsters, and explore the magical city of Bizzaire in this bite-sized pixel-art RPG!

apps.name: Work From Dungeon
apps.short_description: A tiny adventure moves into the corner of your desktop. Click the mage and her monsters fight and grow stronger while you work. Collect and breed 99 monsters, climb toward the last foe waiting at the very end — an idle RPG you never have to stop for.

apps.name: Wove
apps.short_description: A cozy platforming adventure where you explore various worlds as a small doll-like traveler, solving puzzles and unlocking outfits. Play solo, or share the journey with others along the way.

apps.name: Xenogarden
apps.short_description: Xenogarden is a dark sci-fi strategy game where you spread an alien swarm, build synapse nodes, defend your core, and overwhelm human defenders before they destroy your living network and cut the invasion apart.

apps.name: Yo soy páramo
apps.short_description: Lead a clan of survivors and manage humanity's last settlement as the world dies. How long can you hold out? Learn, manage scarce resources, make tough choices, recover powerful technology from the old world, and be the last one standing on Earth.

apps.name: クッキング赤ちゃん
apps.short_description: An adult story and minigame collection featuring Minori. Play eight challenges with clicking, sliding, rhythm, and timing controls. Build your stats, unlock new stages and scenes, and revisit the gallery. Includes difficulty options and repeat modes in supported games.

apps.name: ミステリ―アドベンチャー　犯人はメイド
apps.short_description: The culprit is—the maid. And the protagonist. your mission is to strike down six unsuspecting guests, one by one. But beware—you must never be suspected before your plan is complete. To escape suspicion, engage in heated debates and refute your opponents. Hide your true identity at all costs.

apps.name: 三国·守关录：烽火镇魇
apps.short_description: Hold the passes of a nightmare-haunted Three Kingdoms. Build defenses, recruit legendary generals, trigger battlefield mechanisms and turn the tide with tactical spells in pausable real-time tower defense. 18 battlefields, 13 generals, 7 defense types.

apps.name: 乒乓行
apps.short_description: A roguelite bullet-hell shooter where table tennis meets ancient mythology. Wield your paddle to strike enemies with bouncing balls, retrieve them to attack again, and craft powerful builds through strategic upgrades.

apps.name: 公衆電話
apps.short_description:
You are currently trapped inside a phone booth.
When you pick up the receiver, the number “99” appears on the display, and a countdown begins.
From among the vast number of flyers covering the walls on all four sides, find and peel off two flyers with exactly the same design that aren’t overlapping.

apps.name: 動物繁殖研究所
apps.short_description: Run 43 hands-on experiments, get to know four companions, and build a place for research and everyday life. Choose your words, expand your facilities, cook and rest, and discover your own daily rhythm in this single-player simulation.

apps.name: 樸素少女的戀愛直播
apps.short_description: Return to the countryside and reunite with Shizuka, your shy, unassuming, yet surprisingly busty childhood friend! Run the general store, dress her up, take photos, manage her social media, and help her become a streamer in this steamy romance visual novel!

apps.name: 滑动方块
apps.short_description:
This game is a simple casual puzzle game. In the game, you use the arrow keys to get all the yellow blocks to the green flag goal to win~
Weird creativity that leaves you wanting more, various traps that keep you on edge, and fascinating mysterious features are waiting for players to explore~

apps.name: ARK: Aquatica Original Soundtrack
apps.short_description: The soundtrack for ARK: Aquatica, composed by Gareth Coker.

apps.name: Milk outside a bag of milk outside a bag of milk Soundtrack
apps.short_description: Full sountrack of Milk outside a bag of milk outside a bag of milk.

apps.name: Planet Zoo Soundtrack
apps.short_description: Experience seven continents of wonder with the Planet Zoo soundtrack, by J.J. Ipsen. Travel the globe as you listen to a rich and authentic collection of 18 original songs filled with Planet Zoo’s warmth, charm, and endless creativity.

apps.name: Psychopomp Soundtrack
apps.short_description:
This is the Original Soundtrack for [PSYCHOPOMP]
Featuring bizarre sounds of all sorts, experience the dark sounds of that endless abyss yourself!

apps.name: Raspberry's Berry Match Soundtrack
apps.short_description: This is the soundtrack featuring the four BGM tracks used in the game plus one unused track.

apps.name: World of Tanks: HEAT - Launch Soundtrack
apps.short_description: Dive into the sound of HEAT with the game's official release soundtrack—bold, brutal, and built to get you moving.

apps.name: World of Tanks: HEAT - Season 2 Soundtrack
apps.short_description: Step on the blistering soil of Inferno One, the main hotbed of Season 2 "Fire and Ash".
